tasks.short: Calculate and adjust furnace loading amounts

steps.what: Check materials, furnace capacity and process conditions before calculating loading amounts
Calculate nominal material amounts from the checked loading formula
Adjust amounts for specific conditions and confirm the intended furnace load

tasks.design: Configure an existing {OPS_SYSTEM} recipe calculator to calculate nominal amounts from checked inputs and an approved formula. The operator retains material checks, adjustments for specific conditions and confirmation; the calculator does not control equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some nominal load arithmetic was repeated manually between condition checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Recipe calculators can reuse explicit formulas and show their inputs and units.
tasks.still_hard: Material variability and unusual furnace conditions may invalidate the nominal recipe.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognizes when a mathematically correct amount is unsuitable for actual conditions.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of arithmetic time returns to condition checks; loading authority stays unchanged.

reach.role: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
reach.task: Check the identity and measurement units of a material batch

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing recipe calculator can apply explicit loading arithmetic; the proposed furnace-saving estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is material-amount calculation and condition-based adjustment, excluding physical loading, process control and separate recipe engineering.

The operator produces counted s1 inputs: material and batch identifiers, required output amount, measured quantities, units, observed condition, furnace identifier and capacity. The process engineer supplies a versioned formula, limits and required measurements before use; two incremental other-role hours cover formula upkeep. Missing measurements or out-of-range conditions require manual calculation and supervisor consultation, never guessed correction factors.
Test native recipe-calculator configuration before custom code. Existing automatic recipe runtime earns no labour credit; no change to interlocks or equipment control is proposed.
Seven incremental focal hours cover input-map checks and reconciliation; all condition judgement remains in s1 and s3.
unknowns: Current manual arithmetic and available recipe functions
Approved formulas and actual measurement requirements
research_questions: Can the calculator reproduce checked nominal loads while stopping on missing units or unsupported material conditions?

incremental.description: Check mappings and reconcile calculation changes
Maintain approved formula versions and limits

approvals.approved_version: Exact furnace, material batches, quantities, units, condition observations and recipe version; changes void confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R80 gives20 gross minus7 focal upkeep =13 net. Existing automatic recipes or frequent unusual materials support only0-3% conservative saving; physical and condition-based work remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct crane operators and crew members to load vessels while checking actual loading conditions

tasks.design: Keep loading direction with the operator, using the current {DOCS} loading instruction for reference. The operator watches actual progress and confirms communications with the crane operator and crew.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe direction depends on the current vessel, load and crew positions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions support coordination without replacing observation and communication.
tasks.still_hard: Visibility, unexpected movement and misunderstood signals need immediate human response.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices changing conditions and can stop or correct the loading sequence.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in loading coordination responsibility or assumed time.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
reach.task: Coordinate a loading handoff across a production crew

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live crane and crew direction remains human work; document access does not establish a shorter loading coordination task.

assumptions: Boundary is the furnace operator's direction, excluding crane operation, crew handling and separately owned amount calculation. Other workers' labour is unchanged and earns no focal saving.

The authorized loading planner or operator produces confirmed material amounts and sequence before loading begins. During counted s1 the operator checks vessel conditions, gives directions and obtains crew acknowledgements; progress is only recorded after actual confirmation.
Use existing instructions and communications before custom loading software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation, camera or reporting process is introduced.
unknowns: Site loading procedures and communication equipment
research_questions: Is there any separately measurable duplicate recording outside the live loading coordination?

already_counted.description: Observe loading, direct the crew and confirm communications

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine loads and difficult visibility both retain live observation and crew direction; physical crew work is unchanged.

role.altitude: Nominal arithmetic may shrink while condition adjustment and live loading coordination retain the operator's full attention.
reach: Check measurement traceability with inspection colleagues
Coordinate loading handoffs with production supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An operator with traceable nominal calculations and protected attention for actual furnace and loading conditions.
